full_judgment: 15. To part with the records of the case, I think it pertinent to note that although as a proposition of law mere abscondence of the accused' by itself is no proof of his guilt yet, under special circumstances, the willful continued absence of the accused to avoid the trial and to jump the bail on being released by the order of the Court are strong circumstances that certainly react against the presumption of his innocence betraying his guilty conscience. In the instant case the deceptive conduct of accused petitioner Babar Hossain to turn into fugitive by jumping the bail is it clear indication of his guilty conscience and the chain of circumstance considered with other evidence on record leads to the irresistible conclusion that accused petitioner Babar caused the death of victim Akhter Hossain by rash and negligent driving.
